name: olmoe-1b-7b-gguf
why: OLMoE-1B-7B as GGUF, from the model's own authors, for gate A7: the same model as gate A5's, quantized by llama.cpp. Q8_0 keeps every matrix at 8 bits; Q4_K_M keeps most at 4 bits (Q4_K) and some at 6 (Q6_K). The tensors are written unpermuted and the experts stacked in the checkpoint's order, so they map one to one onto reference/olmoe-1b-7b's. config.json and the tokenizer still come from that pin.
